sloka: यथा तव तथान्येषां रक्ष्या दारा निशाचर ।आत्मानमुपमां कृत्वा स्वेषु दारेषु रम्यताम् ।। ५.१९.७।।।।
transliteration: yathā tava tathānyeṣāṁ rakṣyā dārā niśācara ।ātmānamupamāṁ kṛtvā sveṣu dāreṣu ramyatām ।। 5.19.7।।।।

translations.english: She was as though moving towards the knower of the self, the supreme king, Rama with the horses of her resolution yoked to the chariot of her mind.
